mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past 3 months signals an easing cycle, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS decline <2% over 3 months, or returns in non-easing periods are higher.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5.5% triggers concerns about labor market weakening, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 5.5%, or returns in high-unemployment periods are not worse than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signal robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC >0.03 over 60d horizon, or returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising INDPRO (supply) alongside low FEDFUNDS suggests sustained production growth and accommodative policy, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods, or returns in non-late-cycle periods are higher.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting rate hikes that reduce growth prospects, leading to negative 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.5%, or returns in inflationary periods are not worse than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in PAYEMS (employment) and falling UNRATE (lower unemployment) indicate a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC >0.03 over 60d, or returns not significantly positive when both proxies move as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO over the past 6 months reflects robust production capacity, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO rises >2% over 6 months, or returns in non-expanding periods are higher.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, persistent FEDFUNDS above 1.5% combined with falling GDPC1 (contractionary demand) signals slowing growth, leading to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) in tightening cycles, or returns in non-tightening periods are worse.
